The '''M-2 mining probe droid''' was a type of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used in [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. The [[Subtext Mining]] company were known to supply them.

One unit of this sort was on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], where [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and his apprentice, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], used it to investigate a [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] lode. Subtext Mining sabotaged their own droid, hoping to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]&mdash;rather than seeking out the precious metal they desired, the probe instead searched for the flammable gas [[lethane]], and succeeded. The resulting explosion tore through the caverns, and though both Sith escaped, Plagueis used the opportunity to kill Tenebrous.
